items.title: John E. Wood Interview, 1986-06-26
items.q: actually Greg Stafford who ended up giving me a ride from that, where that parade ended up, back down to the French market where he was late playing his gig at the Cafe Mediterranean. And I got into that because he had seen me before the parade started talking to, to Barry Ratton.

ctx.x: Some of those are pitched all higher, you know, and they don't.

And he was, he played, it was a younger guy who was playing it, and he really wasn't very prominent in the music. But, you know, I enjoyed the music tremendously, and I enjoyed the experience of just seeing the brass band out in the streets. I've always thought that that was the appropriate place for that music with the sun shining and everybody enjoying themselves in the street. And it's a glorious, happy sound. But it is a very different sound. I don't really, again, know enough technically about the music to…
